as_told.title: Gary Nolan's UFO crash parts from Vallee are magnesium bismuth

plain: A Stanford professor named Garry Nolan keeps what he says are pieces recovered from crashed UFOs, which he got from Jacques Vallée, a longtime researcher Michels calls 'the godfather of UFO research'. Michels says he has seen the pieces himself in Nolan's lab, that they are magnesium and bismuth, and that Nolan told him such materials might be useful for making micro-sized waveguides, tiny structures that channel energy, for use on Earth. If the pieces are what Nolan says, they would be physical material from a craft not made by people.
